messages:
Rhea: Enterprise asks for HSM-backed BYOK for hosted API. Requirements: monthly rotation, import wrapped keys, vendor attestation, and SIEM forwarding. POC next Thurs. Who can own?
Tom: I can lead the POC. Quick notes: we support envelope encryption with external KMS and KMIP gateways. For on-prem KMIP we need a reachable endpoint or VPN/VPC peering. That can add lead time.
Meera: Runbook sketch:
- Exchange KMS ARN or KMIP endpoint and access principal
- Link alias in console + smoke encrypt/decrypt
- Load test (50–150 TPS) and capture P95/P99
- Trigger rotation and validate zero-downtime promotion
Example CLI: `rw keys link --alias corp-byo --endpoint "kmip://198.51.100.22:5696"`
Rhea: Pricing ask from sales: include BYOK security add-on + one-time KMIP integration fee. Ops uplift if private peering needed.
Tom: Attestation: we accept vendor FIPS/attestation PDFs; remote attestation only if HSM vendor exposes it. Add this as a blocker until customer provides docs.
Meera: Sec-q draft: "Redwood never exports customer master keys; envelope encryption used; key ops logged and exportable to customer SIEM. Key rotation supported via customer KMS or Redwood API."
Legal: Please prepare BYOK addendum template for signature covering custody, attestation acceptance, and deletion workflow.
EngOpsBot: POC infra provisioned: redwood-byo-poc-1783342100. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/poc/1783342100. Logs available to customer sandbox.
Rhea: Thanks — I'll assemble the sec-q answers and the quote, and share calendar invite for Thu 09:30 PT.
